name: G1 whole-robot electrical power model (BMS pack power), v2
equation: P[W] = P0 + sum_groups b_group * sum_{j in group} tau_j^2 * (1 + alpha_cu*(T_j - T_j,start)) + sum_j max(tau_j*dq_j,0) + eta_regen * sum_j min(tau_j*dq_j,0)
change_from_v1: (1) joint types driven by the same actuator model share one copper coefficient (8 instead of 16); (2) copper loss follows the rise of the reported motor temperature since the start of the segment with the temperature coefficient of copper (not fitted). Same data, target and fitting method as v1.
temp_reference: each motor's reported temperature averaged over the first 1.5 s of the segment (robot standing, arms down)

units.P: W, battery pack V*|I| as reported by the BMS

uncertainty.note: sd of a segment-mean prediction = sqrt(parameter part + session_sd^2 + segment_sd^2); parameter part from the bootstrap coefficient sets below

fitted_on.excluded: damping (fsm=1) frames; first 0.8 s of each segment

envelope.conditions: standing / arm gestures / 0.5 m/s commanded walk, step in place, turning; flat floor; slack safety rope; ~28 C ambient; no payload
